reproduction: The Guest native runner was launched with relay_configured=false over a temporary Default Switch, but guest-native-pi-agent.ps1 wrote model_egress=host_allowlisted_model_relay unconditionally.
observation: The raw run status misidentified the actual egress even though the Host start record said guest_direct_network; the same run's session showed the Agent had begun local tool calls before it was stopped.
expected: Run status must reflect the egress selected by the Host launch parameters.
impact: A future comparison could attribute direct Guest success/failure to the wrong relay path; this is an evidence-integrity error, not a model result.
minimal_change: Pass ModelEgress explicitly and write it into the Guest status instead of hardcoding relay.
rollback: Revert the parameter and launch argument; preserve the incorrect run as historical evidence.
verification: New direct run status says guest_direct_network; relay run status says host_allowlisted_model_relay; session/transport evidence agrees.
unresolved_risk: Agent tool calls may still be long-running; monitoring must inspect session events and tool handles before applying a deadline.
